# YOUR FANCY SECTION 1

If you include any picture, you should place the picture (gif or jpeg) in the folder `asset/`. 

**Important:** Name the picture with your QMD file name as a prefix. For example:

- If your file is `fourier.qmd`, name your picture `fourier_euler.jpg`
- If your file is `continuity.qmd`, name your picture `continuity_graph.png`
- If your file is `instructions.qmd`, name your picture `instructions_screenshot.png`

This is to avoid file name collisions when all submissions are collected and compiled.
